name: Natsuki Hikari
source:
Hobbies: Taking care of her siblings, listening to music (anime songs)
Skills: Her jumping ability
Likes: Exercise in general, dishes made from wild vegetables
Dislikes: Greasy things (she hates getting fatter)

A third-year student and the girls' basketball club's president. She is very kind, friendly, has excellent grades, and has also an exceptional body, which has made her very popular with her peers. She has the talent of motivating almost anybody with her words.
